schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs and the section-level language deduction; 4–6 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–11 listening answers; 12 the cover-mark table; 13–17 composition marking, Stíl/Ábhar bands, Cumas Gaeilge criteria and 80-mark table, and the short / off-title reductions; 44 modified marking (SMM). PDF 18–43 are Paper 2; 45–48 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt, scheme slice and composition line is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: The SEC archive serves one 2019 recording (LC001ZLP017IV.mp3, HTTP 200 audio/mpeg on 2026-11-04, 45,394,850 bytes, last modified 21 May 2019); the Higher and Ordinary 2019 schemes print the same transcript (PDF 4: “Triail Chluastuisceana … Fógra 1 (Canúint Uladh) Seo fógra ó RTÉ Raidió na Gaeltachta”), so one recording serves both levels. No other year’s recording is used.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Luaigh dhá …/Scríobh síos dhá …/Scríobh síos an dá …” asks for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists more accepted points than required. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: one card per printed segment (Fógra, Mír, Píosa), as the reviewed 2020–2025 components, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (26 questions, 60 marks).
Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; each of the nine printed titles is its own whole 100-mark card. AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 + Fógra 2 8; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 6 + Mír 2 8) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 6 + Mír 2 8); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 8 + Píosa 2 6), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).

Layout: 2019 prints no answer booklet. The cover (PDF 1) carries the instructions; Cuid A is on paper page 2, B on 3–4, C on 5; the composition Treoracha are on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; page 8 is blank.

Scheme: the same parts as 2020 one PDF page later. The listening answer key (PDF 7–11) ends at “Léirigh na marcanna mar seo ar chlúdach na Cluastuisceana:”, which opens the cover-mark table on its own page (PDF 12); 2019 prints no annotation-symbol table.
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3; it is one section-level deduction, stated in each card note without being applied.

Composition: 2019 prints no S1–S4 grades; scheme PDF 17 prints the reductions for a short or partly off-title attempt (Stíl 4/3/2, Ábhar 13/11/9, Gaeilge 68/56/44), lifted beside the Stíl criterion. The marking text on PDF 13 is cut before the printed score boxes (“Stíl (5) = …”).
Title A(e) is printed over two lines (“… míshuaimhneach” / “sa lá atá inniu ann.”); the card joins them as one title.
Paper page 7 prints the A box heading with a SymbolMT dash (U+F02D); it sits only in the raw selection-decision line, never in a card.
